items.name: tokens
items.title: TonalDepth Tokens
items.description: The shared TonalDepth CSS custom properties and body defaults. Install this once, then TonalDepth components stop redeclaring the same tokens.

items.name: button
items.title: TonalDepth Button
items.description: A typed TonalDepth action button with five variants, three sizes, and loading state.

items.name: badge
items.title: TonalDepth Badge
items.description: A typed TonalDepth status badge with neutral, brand, success, accent, and danger variants.

items.name: card
items.title: TonalDepth Card
items.description: A typed TonalDepth surface with raised, flat, and inset depth treatments, header, title, and content slots.

items.name: input
items.title: TonalDepth Input
items.description: A typed TonalDepth single-line text input with optional leading and trailing slots and an invalid state.

items.name: textarea
items.title: TonalDepth Textarea
items.description: A typed TonalDepth multi-line text area matched to the Input treatment.

items.name: form-field
items.title: TonalDepth FormField
items.description: A typed TonalDepth label, help text, error text, and control wrapper that wires ARIA relationships for any single child control.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: TonalDepth Checkbox
items.description: A typed TonalDepth checkbox with an owned label and native input semantics.

items.name: radio
items.title: TonalDepth Radio
items.description: A typed TonalDepth radio and radio group that shares a name via context and honors fieldset disabled state.

items.name: switch
items.title: TonalDepth Switch
items.description: A typed TonalDepth toggle switch backed by a role=switch checkbox with an owned label.

items.name: alert
items.title: TonalDepth Alert
items.description: A typed TonalDepth persistent notice with info, success, warning, and error variants and an optional dismiss control.

items.name: tabs
items.title: TonalDepth Tabs
items.description: A typed TonalDepth tab list and single tab panel with arrow-key navigation and controlled or uncontrolled selection.

items.name: table
items.title: TonalDepth Table
items.description: A typed TonalDepth semantic table set (container, table, head, body, row, header cell, data cell) with responsive containment.

items.name: kpi
items.title: TonalDepth KPI
items.description: A typed TonalDepth KPI card and responsive grid for eyebrow label, display value, trend delta, and optional sparkline.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: TonalDepth Tooltip
items.description: A typed TonalDepth tooltip that wraps a single child element and reveals a positioned tip on hover, focus, or open prop.

items.name: dialog
items.title: TonalDepth Dialog
items.description: A typed TonalDepth modal dialog with focus trapping, Escape and click-outside dismissal, header, description, and footer slots.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: TonalDepth DropdownMenu
items.description: A typed TonalDepth dropdown menu with a single-selection menuitemradio list and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: toast
items.title: TonalDepth Toast
items.description: A typed TonalDepth toast provider and hook that queues info, success, and error notifications with auto-dismiss.

items.name: chart-container
items.title: TonalDepth ChartContainer
items.description: A typed TonalDepth chart figure with title, meta, hidden description for assistive tech, and optional legend.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: TonalDepth FilterBar
items.description: A typed TonalDepth multi-select filter chip row with per-chip count, disabled state, and clear-all action.

items.name: application-shell
items.title: TonalDepth ApplicationShell
items.description: A typed TonalDepth application shell with grouped sidebar navigation, identity slot, main header, and content area.

items.name: page-patterns
items.title: TonalDepth PagePatterns
items.description: Typed TonalDepth page compositions: DashboardPage, DashboardPanel, DataManagementPage, PageState.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: TonalDepth IconButton
items.description: The lamp: a round icon-only button, or a pill with a label, whose icon carries the interaction state — unlit at rest, lit on hover, brighter on press — while the label holds its ink. Neutral, papaya, azure, invert and per-channel tones.

items.name: article-card
items.title: TonalDepth ArticleCard
items.description: A typed TonalDepth blog/article card: optional cover, category eyebrow, title, excerpt, an "In this piece" well of the tools, files and datasets the piece carries, an author and a date + read-time meta line, and an optional whole-card link that takes the depth ladder.

items.name: case-card
items.title: TonalDepth CaseCard
items.description: A typed TonalDepth case-study card: eyebrow, outcome title, summary, outcome metrics in mono, and an optional whole-card link that takes the depth ladder.

items.name: feature-card
items.title: TonalDepth FeatureCard
items.description: A typed TonalDepth feature card with an icon lamp, bullet points and a footer slot, plus a density-explicit grid. Tone moves the icon's ink, never a fill.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: TonalDepth ComparisonTable
items.description: A typed TonalDepth comparison table: criteria down, options across, booleans as marks with a text equivalent, and the argued-for column set as the ladder's selected step.

items.name: cta-banner
items.title: TonalDepth CtaBanner
items.description: A typed TonalDepth closing call to action. It carries weight through depth and scale rather than a brand fill, and takes library Buttons in its actions slot.

items.name: timeline
items.title: TonalDepth Timeline
items.description: A typed TonalDepth ordered sequence for phases, process and roadmaps. State reads from the dot's depth, and the current phase is announced in text.

items.name: prose
items.title: TonalDepth Prose
items.description: A typed TonalDepth long-form container that styles authored HTML — headings, lists, quotes, code, tables and rules — for articles, guides and legal pages.

items.name: rect-title
items.title: TonalDepth RectTitle
items.description: A typed TonalDepth rectangle title. It splits a headline into balanced lines and scales each one so the block squares off, in the display face at h1 to h3.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: TonalDepth ThemeToggle
items.description: The system's theme switch — a round icon button whose sun and moon are lamps. It keeps `data-theme` stamped on the document, including in the unstamped system state, and remembers the choice.

items.name: site-navigation
items.title: TonalDepth SiteNavigation
items.description: The marketing site navigation — a raised pill that sticks flush, retracts on the way down and returns on the way up, with mega panels held at one size whatever they hold. Publishes `--nav-offset` for in-page sticky toolbars.

items.name: footer
items.title: TonalDepth Footer
items.description: The site footer, composed from a brand band, link columns, a contact well and a bottom rule. Server-renderable, so the whole link inventory stays in the crawled HTML.

items.name: filament-button
items.title: TonalDepth FilamentButton
items.description: A typed TonalDepth tab button that reports its state with a lit filament rather than a fill. Four states — off, dim on hover, held, and brightest on press — along either the inline-start or the top edge.

items.name: side-tabs
items.title: TonalDepth SideTabs
items.description: A typed TonalDepth sideways tab set built on the filament. Vertical with labels, collapsed to a glyph rail, or laid horizontally for mobile, with the full WAI-ARIA tabs keyboard pattern.

items.name: split-button
items.title: TonalDepth SplitButton
items.description: A typed TonalDepth split button: one action with its alternatives folded behind a disclosure. Defaults to an action, or withholds it until the reader chooses when the choice is load-bearing.

items.name: search-bar
items.title: TonalDepth SearchBar
items.description: A typed TonalDepth search field, carved into the surface rather than raised, with an optional suggestion listbox following the ARIA combobox pattern.

items.name: frame
items.title: TonalDepth Frame
items.description: A raised plate with a well cut into it — the housing anything measured lives inside. Chrome is raised, data is recessed, so a chart or a table reads as data without a single border.

items.name: progress
items.title: TonalDepth Progress
items.description: A typed TonalDepth progress meter. The track is carved into the surface and the filled length is the only thing carrying colour, because it is a measured quantity.

items.name: copy-chip
items.title: TonalDepth CopyChip
items.description: A typed TonalDepth chip that puts a machine value on the clipboard. Success is reported in ink and glyph, never as a tinted plate.

items.name: toc
items.title: TonalDepth TableOfContents
items.description: A typed TonalDepth on-this-page rail. The seam is a filament: always present, off and grey, and the current section lights its own segment.

items.name: range
items.title: TonalDepth Range
items.description: A typed TonalDepth slider on a carved track. A real input[type=range], so the keyboard and assistive technology behave natively.

items.name: data-list
items.title: TonalDepth DataList
items.description: A typed TonalDepth definition list for four to six fields about one record — where a table's header row would be overhead.

items.name: faq
items.title: TonalDepth Faq
items.description: A typed TonalDepth question list that opens in place. Real buttons with aria-expanded, and answers hidden with `hidden` so they leave in-page search too.

items.name: link-cells
items.title: TonalDepth LinkCells
items.description: A typed TonalDepth grid of onward links. The whole cell is the target, so there is no separate read-more.

items.name: logo-strip
items.title: TonalDepth LogoStrip
items.description: A typed TonalDepth wall of real client artwork — monochrome at rest, full colour on hover, with each mark's name carried as its alternative text.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: TonalDepth FileTree
items.description: A typed TonalDepth repository or docs tree. Rows press rather than tint, and the chevron is a direction mark rather than a lamp.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: TonalDepth PricingTable
items.description: A typed TonalDepth plan grid — a price, what it includes, and the way to take it. The featured plan is reported by depth and papaya ink, never by a fill.

items.name: code-block
items.title: TonalDepth CodeBlock
items.description: A typed TonalDepth code listing, housed in a Frame with a copy chip in the corner. It does no highlighting — pass pre-highlighted markup.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: TonalDepth Breadcrumbs
items.description: A typed TonalDepth breadcrumb trail in the three forms the design system draws — chevrons, slashes, and the condensed housed bar — on one separator prop.

items.name: pagination
items.title: TonalDepth Pagination
items.description: A typed TonalDepth page trail with a truncating range. The page being read rests recessed with papaya ink rather than being filled with the brand colour.

items.name: map
items.title: TonalDepth Map
items.description: A typed TonalDepth static locator map — a carved ground, an optional graticule and pins as lamps in sockets. No tile provider and no network call.

items.name: profile-card
items.title: TonalDepth ProfileCard
items.description: A typed TonalDepth person card — the mark beside the name, or above it with a bio. One card for both the profile card and the team wall.

items.name: mega-cascade
items.title: TonalDepth MegaCascade
items.description: A typed TonalDepth three-level cascading mega panel — categories, subcategories, items — each column a well, with roving-tabindex rails.

items.name: mega-tabs
items.title: TonalDepth MegaTabs
items.description: A typed TonalDepth two-column mega panel: a rail of options on the left, one pane on the right.

items.name: mega-grid
items.title: TonalDepth MegaGrid
items.description: A typed TonalDepth mega panel of cards, housed in a well rather than sitting on the sheet, plus the footer action rail.

items.name: mega-columns
items.title: TonalDepth MegaColumns
items.description: A typed TonalDepth wide mega panel: a feature panel that makes the case beside titled columns of destinations, with a footer rail.
